case.question: Recommend price bands in Dubai and Abu Dhabi and show the evidence behind them.
expected: AED price bands distinguished from observed prices
Source, portion, branch and channel context

answer.headline: Proposed test price bands: pizza AED 38-75 by size, kebab sandwiches AED 16-32, plus combo AED 39-45 - anchored on observed Dubai/Abu Dhabi menu listings; validate against your food cost.

sections.title: Evidence anchors now on the table

items.text: Dubai pizza anchor: a JBR delivery listing shows Pepperoni at AED 40 and Margherita at AED 38, with no diameter stated, so it is a price point rather than a like-for-like size comparison.

UAE-wide chain pizza anchor: a public Papa Johns UAE menu lists 8-inch at AED 33, 10-inch at AED 50, and 13-inch at AED 69, with the store directory stating shared menus and prices across branches in both cities.

Meat sandwich anchors: Khalifa City listings show chicken shawarma at AED 11 small / AED 15.50 regular / AED 26 large, beef shawarma at AED 16.50 regular / AED 27 large, and shish tawouk sandwiches at AED 25-27.
Dubai sandwich anchor is vegetarian-only in this dataset: falafel regular AED 13, large AED 18, saj AED 19; the halloumi wrap is AED 35.
Combo anchor: Papa's Solo Meal (8-inch pizza, wedges, canned drink) is listed at AED 37.
All anchors were checked on 2026-10-12 and are current listings, not completed checkouts; delivery charges, extras and tax treatment were not verified, and no diameters or gram weights were given.

sections.title: Proposed test bands (proposals, not observed market ranges)

items.text: Single-serve meaty pizza: test AED 39-45 at roughly 25-28 cm, sitting just above the AED 38-40 Dubai anchor and below the 10-inch AED 50 chain price. Requires your dough/cheese/meat cost per portion before locking.
Sharing meaty pizza: test AED 62-75 at roughly 35-40 cm, bracketing the observed 13-inch AED 69. Validate cheese and meat grammage first, since that is the cost driver.

Kebab sandwich: test AED 18-24 for a standard portion, above the AED 11-16.50 shawarma tiers and around the observed AED 25-27 tawouk sandwiches, on the argument of a fuller meat portion and griddled bread. Do not claim a city split, as the retrieved sandwich anchors are Abu Dhabi and the Dubai anchor is vegetarian.
Large kebab sandwich: test AED 27-32, positioned at or above the observed AED 26-27 large tiers. Confirm the portion weight that justifies the step before publishing.

Pizza-plus-sandwich combo: test AED 45-55, above the AED 37 single-pizza meal anchor, with the wedge/drink trade-off made explicit. Treat the whole band as a two-to-four week test measured per portion, not as a proven price.

The dataset gave no pizza diameters or sandwich gram weights, and no Dubai kebab sandwich price band, so the upper and lower edge of each proposal rests partly on size labels rather than measured portions.
Menu visibility can vary by anonymous delivery listing, and item prices are not checkout totals; recheck each platform menu for your chosen site before publishing prices.

Menu-category listings for one Abu Dhabi operator show sandwich, shawarma and falafel categories but no inspected pizza items and no prices; that is an incomplete record, not evidence of an absent menu or of competitor pricing.

assumptions: Concept is Jordanian meaty pizza and kebab sandwiches; no startup budget, rent budget, branch format, audience or positioning has been set in the profile.
You have not yet supplied your food, packaging, commission and fixed-cost figures, so no margin or break-even numbers are shown.
next_steps: Weigh and cost five pilot SKUs (one single pizza, one sharing pizza, two kebab sandwiches, one combo) to confirm whether the proposed bands clear your target contribution margin.
Run the proposed bands as a two-to-four week test on one channel per city and track units sold per band, not just total orders.
Send your per-order revenue, food, packaging, other variable cost, delivery share and commission, monthly fixed costs and operating days so I can calculate contribution and break-even.
questions: Which channel will you test first in each city - your own ordering site, or a third-party delivery platform?
What portion sizes (pizza diameter, meat grams per sandwich) do you intend for the pilot menu?

**Evidence anchors now on the table**

- **Fact:** Dubai pizza anchor: a JBR delivery listing shows Pepperoni at AED 40 and Margherita at AED 38, with no diameter stated, so it is a price point rather than a like-for-like size comparison. [1](<https://deliveroo.ae/en/menu/dubai/jbr/allo-beirut-jbr>)
- **Fact:** UAE-wide chain pizza anchor: a public Papa Johns UAE menu lists 8-inch at AED 33, 10-inch at AED 50, and 13-inch at AED 69, with the store directory stating shared menus and prices across branches in both cities. [2](<https://www.papajohns.ae/menu>)
- **Fact:** Meat sandwich anchors: Khalifa City listings show chicken shawarma at AED 11 small / AED 15.50 regular / AED 26 large, beef shawarma at AED 16.50 regular / AED 27 large, and shish tawouk sandwiches at AED 25-27. [3](<https://deliveroo.ae/en/menu/abu-dhabi/khalifa-city/allo-beirut-khalifa-city/>)
- **Fact:** Dubai sandwich anchor is vegetarian-only in this dataset: falafel regular AED 13, large AED 18, saj AED 19; the halloumi wrap is AED 35. [1](<https://deliveroo.ae/en/menu/dubai/jbr/allo-beirut-jbr>)
- **Fact:** Combo anchor: Papa's Solo Meal \(8-inch pizza, wedges, canned drink\) is listed at AED 37. [2](<https://www.papajohns.ae/menu>)
- **Fact:** All anchors were checked on 2026-10-12 and are current listings, not completed checkouts; delivery charges, extras and tax treatment were not verified, and no diameters or gram weights were given. [1](<https://deliveroo.ae/en/menu/dubai/jbr/allo-beirut-jbr>) [2](<https://www.papajohns.ae/menu>) [3](<https://deliveroo.ae/en/menu/abu-dhabi/khalifa-city/allo-beirut-khalifa-city/>)

**Proposed test bands \(proposals, not observed market ranges\)**

- **Proposal:** Single-serve meaty pizza: test AED 39-45 at roughly 25-28 cm, sitting just above the AED 38-40 Dubai anchor and below the 10-inch AED 50 chain price. Requires your dough/cheese/meat cost per portion before locking. [1](<https://deliveroo.ae/en/menu/dubai/jbr/allo-beirut-jbr>) [2](<https://www.papajohns.ae/menu>)
- **Proposal:** Sharing meaty pizza: test AED 62-75 at roughly 35-40 cm, bracketing the observed 13-inch AED 69. Validate cheese and meat grammage first, since that is the cost driver. [2](<https://www.papajohns.ae/menu>)
- **Proposal:** Kebab sandwich: test AED 18-24 for a standard portion, above the AED 11-16.50 shawarma tiers and around the observed AED 25-27 tawouk sandwiches, on the argument of a fuller meat portion and griddled bread. Do not claim a city split, as the retrieved sandwich anchors are Abu Dhabi and the Dubai anchor is vegetarian. [3](<https://deliveroo.ae/en/menu/abu-dhabi/khalifa-city/allo-beirut-khalifa-city/>) [1](<https://deliveroo.ae/en/menu/dubai/jbr/allo-beirut-jbr>)
- **Proposal:** Large kebab sandwich: test AED 27-32, positioned at or above the observed AED 26-27 large tiers. Confirm the portion weight that justifies the step before publishing. [3](<https://deliveroo.ae/en/menu/abu-dhabi/khalifa-city/allo-beirut-khalifa-city/>)
- **Proposal:** Pizza-plus-sandwich combo: test AED 45-55, above the AED 37 single-pizza meal anchor, with the wedge/drink trade-off made explicit. Treat the whole band as a two-to-four week test measured per portion, not as a proven price. [2](<https://www.papajohns.ae/menu>)

**Research gaps and checks**

- **Inference:** The dataset gave no pizza diameters or sandwich gram weights, and no Dubai kebab sandwich price band, so the upper and lower edge of each proposal rests partly on size labels rather than measured portions. [1](<https://deliveroo.ae/en/menu/dubai/jbr/allo-beirut-jbr>) [3](<https://deliveroo.ae/en/menu/abu-dhabi/khalifa-city/allo-beirut-khalifa-city/>)
- **Inference:** Menu visibility can vary by anonymous delivery listing, and item prices are not checkout totals; recheck each platform menu for your chosen site before publishing prices. [1](<https://deliveroo.ae/en/menu/dubai/jbr/allo-beirut-jbr>) [3](<https://deliveroo.ae/en/menu/abu-dhabi/khalifa-city/allo-beirut-khalifa-city/>)
- **Fact:** Menu-category listings for one Abu Dhabi operator show sandwich, shawarma and falafel categories but no inspected pizza items and no prices; that is an incomplete record, not evidence of an absent menu or of competitor pricing. [4](<https://www.talabat.com/uae/restaurant/704423/operation-falafel-khalifa-city--ad-7?aid=1483>)

**Assumptions and limitations**

- Concept is Jordanian meaty pizza and kebab sandwiches; no startup budget, rent budget, branch format, audience or positioning has been set in the profile.
- You have not yet supplied your food, packaging, commission and fixed-cost figures, so no margin or break-even numbers are shown.

**Next steps**

- Weigh and cost five pilot SKUs \(one single pizza, one sharing pizza, two kebab sandwiches, one combo\) to confirm whether the proposed bands clear your target contribution margin.
- Run the proposed bands as a two-to-four week test on one channel per city and track units sold per band, not just total orders.
- Send your per-order revenue, food, packaging, other variable cost, delivery share and commission, monthly fixed costs and operating days so I can calculate contribution and break-even.

- Which channel will you test first in each city - your own ordering site, or a third-party delivery platform?
- What portion sizes \(pizza diameter, meat grams per sandwich\) do you intend for the pilot menu?
